g.text: Sinusoidal AM produces a carrier and two equal sidebands

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Positive-frequency line spectrum reports sinusoidal peak amplitudes; a two-sided Fourier spectrum would halve each amplitude. Carrier fc=10 kHz, message
fm=1 kHz, sideband amplitude μAc/2=0.3 V, occupied frequency span2 kHz. Envelope detector model assumes no overmodulation.
